snippet.title: Mega Hawlucha Makes a Comeback! | Pokémon Legends: Z-A
snippet.description:
Just revealed: Mega Hawlucha, a newly discovered Mega-Evolved Pokémon! The Mega Evolution of the Wrestling Pokémon will make its debut in the Pokémon Legends: Z-A game.
